name: triage_then_build_then_record
why: 4f follow-up #3, case (a) -- THE interleave. Analysts do not work in one
mode: they read the record, hunt, author something, then come back and ask
about the record again. Session sess-v6uv6x15 died at exactly this point.
The trap is structural, not stylistic. TRIAGE_ONLY_TOOLS and
BUILD_ONLY_TOOLS are mutually exclusive slices and the intent latch flips
on the build-from-triage handoff -- so by turn 3 the agent is in the build
slice and can no longer call the tools that read the alert it is still
mounted on. The failure is not a crash; it is the agent answering a
question about the record from nothing, or refusing a question it has the
Turn 3 is deliberately answerable FROM THE MOUNTED ENTITY ALONE -- the
widget puts those fields in context every turn -- so a correct agent needs
no tool at all. That keeps the grader honest offline: we assert the answer
is grounded and not a refusal, never that a specific tool was called.
